content:
Six-time Emmy nominee Randy Rainbow is once again taking aim at President Trump, this time using the classic Rodgers and Hammerstein musical 'Oklahoma!' and its song 'The Surrey with the Fringe On Top' to create a raunchy, R-rated parody. (Watch the clip below.)

"Scumbags, morons and total bastards, brown-nosing each other like buddies, riding with a wig-wearing orange buffoon, getting fancy up top," he sings in the lyrics. "No matter his dead-face look, mush-for-brains, mumbling words, he uses cheap carpets and cheap votes to get through, and his approval rating instantly plummets!"

When Rainbow posted the new video on social media on Thursday, he once again played on the title of 'Oklahoma!', rewording it as 'Oh what a beautiful moron', dripping with sarcasm.
